title: E-FRC-0178: an audit of the Hermitian eigensolver: its eigenvectors fail to span a degenerate eigenspace, so the...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0178 in the gauge arena: an audit of the Hermitian eigensolver: its eigenvectors fail to span a degenerate eigenspace, so the matrix sign built on them is not a sign, and the two overlap-fermion condensate experiments passed their free-theory control only because of it: the free overlap's exact zero modes at p = 0 (densities 0.04 and 1/9) vanish under the shipped solver.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
